body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. READ-ONLY REVIEW of eaeb3da2a0f4d245b9abef1b0e6a047c57946aa0 — ACCEPT.

Exact SHA confirmed. Parent is current main 6dd3ca6. I did not rerun the gate. Inspected the six reserved files in /private/tmp/storymodel4s-wog-final2.

CONSTRUCTOR / NaN
  - `final class WeightedCoverage private`, not a case class. `of` is the only door.
  - Finite check runs BEFORE `weight < 0.0` and before `conditioningWeight == 0.0`. NaN cannot fail-open into the quotient.
  - Empty observed → AllMissing; observed zeros → Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight); positive weight → Observed(numerator/weight). Numerator exceeding weight refuses.
  - `Estimate.observed` still admits NaN on NodeSummary. `compute` then throws. Ugly, fail-closed. Not this bead's job to seal Estimate.

DISCRIMINATOR is live on the production path
  - FeaturesIntegrationSuite builds one-heavy vs two-light through `RecallSignature.compute`, not `of`.
  - Same estimate (independently recomputed middle visitation), same conditioning weight 1.0, coverage 1 vs 2. `assertNotEquals` on coverage. Fixture fails if it cannot find three distinct visitations.

PROJECTION
  - Value is `estimate.toOption`. Support is `coverage.fraction`. Missing estimate is MissingComponent. Test pins weakestSupport to the carrier's support.

FORGE
  - AlignBoundarySuite is outside `storymodel4s.align`. Same-shape control `AlignForgeControl.fromProduct`. WeightedCoverage refuses Mirror, fromProduct, new, copy, Product.

ADR / codec
  - No `RecallSignature` in codec/. The amendment's "no codec to migrate" is accurate. Adding one later must round-trip the full carrier.

NARROWS, not blocks
  - First integration test still uses `m >= b - 1e-12`. The later discriminator is the assertion that can fail.
  - I did not rerun platforms or the case-class mutation.

I hold nothing. Chief can land.
